description: Offline audit only; no tests, benchmarks, encoding, decoding or builds were run. VERIFIED means evidence identity and accounting reconciled, not that the comparison passed.

methodology.identity: Every native JSON, CSV and log matches its recorded SHA-256 in plan and results. Native JSON equals embedded results. Fixture/source manifests and software-reference metadata/commands match recorded hashes. Compressed payloads and deleted raw references were not reread or regenerated.
methodology.ids: Verified fixture access-unit IDs are 0..units-1 with one output each. replay.mm uses unit ID + loop*(max unit ID+1), giving expected IDs 0..offered-1.
methodology.missing: Missing CSV IDs reconcile with scheduler_drops+rejected. Nonoutput IDs have a terminal CSV row but no status=0/displayed_outputs=1 output. Missing-output IDs are the union of these disjoint sets.
methodology.warmup: First 120 offered frames are IDs 0..119; post-warmup accounting checks every ID >=120 independently of latency exclusions.
methodology.recovery: Smallest delivered ID greater than the last lost ID. It can differ from the first chronological output. Recovery time uses sink_entry_ns minus zero-jitter scheduled origin reconstructed from CSV IDs and floor(1e9/fps).
methodology.correctness: Verify expected YUV420 code sample count W*H*3/2*fixture_units, zero max/mean error, independent FFmpeg HEVC reference metadata/command hashes, raw-reference hash linkage, full outputs, hardware and IOSurface/Metal/retained-buffer checks. Deleted raw reference bytes were not redecoded.
methodology.limits: Recovery at random-access frame 60 is an observation, not a diagnosed cause. Absent CSV IDs cannot distinguish individual scheduler-drop branches. thermal_state is an end-of-trial reading, not continuous telemetry. Complete post-warmup delivery does not erase startup loss.
